beats.text: Frequency means how often a category or value occurs. Validate means check the data against the question and collection rules before counting. Use a consistent spelling, check missing answers with the collector, and investigate duplicate pupil records. Matching answers from different pupils are not duplicates. Never quietly invent a missing answer.
